brief:
The U.S. midterm elections delivered a sharp rejection of Iran war policies and the American-Israel military relationship, according to defense analyst Bill Hartung cited by Mondoweiss. However, Hartung cautioned that not all policy adjustments emerging from the changed political landscape will benefit Palestinians.

The analyst's assessment suggests a complex picture for the Palestine movement despite the electoral rebuke of hawkish foreign policy positions. Some proposed policy changes in response to shifting political winds may carry unintended consequences or prove insufficient for Palestinian interests.
dek: The U.S. midterm results were a stunning rebuke of the Iran war and the U.S.-Israel relationship, but defense analyst Bill Hartung says not all the policy changes being proposed in response to shifting political winds will help Palestinians.
title: U.S.-Israel military ties shift after midterms, Hartung warns Palestinian impact unclear
